paragraphs: I’ve thought about adding a messaging channel through the stream hub—the relay behind the phone viewer—for this. I haven’t built it yet. So far, I mostly copy or rephrase things between agents myself. For example, if I hit an AgentTerm bug during other work, I take it to a separate session so the original conversation stays focused.
What kinds of work do you have Codex and Claude hand off to each other? A concrete example would help me think through what that channel should support.
